cases.title: Two allotments: one money block per farm
steps: Press Harsha Bhat on the sign-in screen
Press 'Investors' in the menu
Press 'Joseph Mathew' in the investors list
Press the 'Money' tab
expected: The Money section shows one block for each of Joseph Mathew's two farms.
A line reads 'Total across 2 farms'.

cases.title: Two allotments: the receipt needs a farm picked
steps: Press Meena Raghavan on the sign-in screen
Press 'Investors' in the menu
Press 'Joseph Mathew' in the investors list
Press the 'Money' tab
Press the button that records a receipt for the balance
expected: The panel asks which farm, 'pick one'.
The panel says a receipt belongs to one allotment and is not saved until a farm is picked.

cases.title: One allotment: the farm is already picked
steps: Press Meena Raghavan on the sign-in screen
Press 'Investors' in the menu
Press 'Prakash Bhat' in the investors list
Press the 'Money' tab
Press 'The balance'
expected: The panel says 'Their only allotment — the receipt is linked to it.'

cases.title: Finance sees the ARL holdings panel, read only
steps: Press Harsha Bhat on the sign-in screen
Press 'Investors' in the menu
Press 'Sanjay Kulkarni' in the investors list
Press the 'What they hold' tab
expected: The record shows an 'ARL holdings' panel marked read only that lists a CCD holding.
The ARL holdings panel offers no Add, Edit or Delete button.

steps: Press Imran Sheikh on the sign-in screen
Press 'Investors' in the menu
Press 'Sanjay Kulkarni' in the investors list

cases.title: Finance sees the payouts due this month with Mark paid

Press 'Payments' in the menu
expected: The page shows a queue of payouts due this month, reading '13 scheduled in Sep 2026'.
